---

# INCIDENT REPORT: NetSupport RAT Infection
**Date:** 2024-11-26  
**Evidence Source:** 2024-11-26-traffic-analysis-exercise.pcap

## INFECTED HOST IDENTIFICATION

**IPv4 Address:** 10.11.26.183  
**MAC Address:** d0:57:7b:ce:fc:8b (Intel device)  
**Windows Hostname:** DESKTOP-B8TQK49  
**Domain:** NEMOTODES (nemotoads.health)  
**Logged-in User Account:** oboomwald

---

## MALWARE CLASSIFICATION

**Malware Family:** NetSupport RAT (Remote Access Trojan)  
**Attribution:** Signature-confirmed  
**Evidence:** 
- Suricata rule match: "ETPRO TROJAN NetSupport RAT CnC Activity"
- HTTP User-Agent: NetSupport Manager/1.3
- Protocol analysis: POST requests to C&C with NetSupport command structure (CMD=POLL, CMD=ENCD with encrypted data payloads)

---

## INDICATORS OF COMPROMISE

### Command-and-Control Endpoints (IP:Port)
1. **194.180.191.64:443** (Primary C&C server)
   - Protocol: HTTPS/HTTP
   - Traffic Pattern: Repeated POST requests to /fakeurl.htm with encrypted command payloads
   - Suricata Alerts: "ETPRO TROJAN Malicious NetSupport Rat CnC Checkin", "ETPRO TROJAN NetSupport RAT CnC Activity"

2. **193.42.38.139:443** (Secondary C&C / malware domain server)
   - Associated Domain: modandcrackedapk.com
   - TLS SNI: modandcrackedapk.com
   - Protocol: TLSv1.0 (deprecated/suspicious)

3. **104.26.1.231:80** (NetSupport geolocation lookup server)
   - Associated Domain: geo.netsupportsoftware.com
   - Traffic: GeoIP lookup (POST to /location/loca.asp)

4. **104.26.0.231:443** (NetSupport geolocation alternate)
   - Associated Domain: geo.netsupportsoftware.com

5. **172.67.68.212:443** (NetSupport geolocation alternate)
   - Associated Domain: geo.netsupportsoftware.com

### Malicious Domains
- **modandcrackedapk.com** (ZPHP malicious domain indicator)
  - Resolved to: 193.42.38.139
  - DNS lookups originated from 10.11.26.183
  - TLS connections observed

- **geo.netsupportsoftware.com** (NetSupport legitimate domain, hijacked for C&C geolocation)
  - Resolved to: 104.26.1.231, 104.26.0.231, 172.67.68.212

### Malicious URLs
- **http://194.180.191.64/fakeurl.htm** (C&C polling endpoint)
  - HTTP POST requests with NetSupport Manager protocol
  - Command structure: CMD=POLL, CMD=ENCD (encrypted data)
  - Repeated beaconing pattern (approximately 60-second intervals)

### Transferred File Names / Hashes
No file transfers detected in cleartext. C&C protocol uses encrypted data payloads (CMD=ENCD with binary data). No SHA256 hashes are visible in the network traffic.

---

## ATTACK SUMMARY

The Windows workstation DESKTOP-B8TQK49 (user: oboomwald) is infected with NetSupport RAT. The malware maintains persistent communication with the primary C&C server at 194.180.191.64 via HTTPS POST requests to /fakeurl.htm. Secondary infrastructure includes the malicious domain modandcrackedapk.com and legitimate NetSupport infrastructure repurposed for geolocation tracking. The compromise enables remote command execution, file transfer, and system reconnaissance capabilities on the victim host.
